vibe: Linear / Superhuman meets Financial Precision. Confident, specific, high data density but perfectly clear.

accent.description: Used only for primary CTAs (like Connect Gmail) and trust elements to establish financial safety.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-heading font-black leading-tight text-primary
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl tracking-tight font-heading font-bold text-primary
hierarchy.h3: text-xl md:text-2xl tracking-tight font-heading font-semibold text-primary

spacing_and_layout.scale: Generous scaling for macro-layout (empty states) and dense precision for micro-layout (ledgers).
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-inverse hover:bg-primary-hover active:bg-primary-active rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-body font-semibold text-sm transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-surface text-primary border border-border hover:border-border-hover hover:bg-muted rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-body font-medium text-sm transition-colors
buttons.accent_cta: bg-accent text-inverse hover:bg-accent-hover rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-body font-semibold text-base transition-colors shadow-sm ring-1 ring-accent/20

tables.wrapper: w-full border border-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-surface
tables.header_cell: px-4 py-3 text-xs font-body font-semibold text-secondary uppercase tracking-wider
tables.cell: px-4 py-3 text-sm font-body text-primary align-middle
tables.cell_number: px-4 py-3 text-sm font-mono text-primary text-right tabular-nums
rules: Right-align all currency and numerical values.
Use Monospace font for invoice refs, dates, and amounts.
Use a subtle hover state on rows to aid visual tracking.

pills_and_badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border font-body

empty_state.layout: Flex column, centered content, max-w-2xl mx-auto text-center gap-8
empty_state.cta_wrapper: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 mt-4

micro_interactions.hover: Subtle border darken on cards (border-border -> border-border-hover). Background shifts to muted (#F5F5F5) for interactive rows.

icons.usage: Use icons sparingly. Avoid icon-soup. Use them to clarify status or action.

empty_state_texture.description: Minimalist white abstract background, useful for a very subtle 10% opacity backdrop behind the empty state hero section to add depth without noise.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass APCA / WCAG AA minimums. Minimum 4.5:1 for body text. #0A0A0A on #FFFFFF gives max contrast.
accessibility.focus_management: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements. Buttons must have explicit :focus-visible states.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Add '@fontsource/manrope' and '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono' or load via Google Fonts. Add 'react-icons' for the Google OAuth logo (FcGoogle).
COMPONENTS: Prefer raw HTML/Tailwind for the Empty State to ensure exact spacing control. Use Shadcn customized components for Data Tables, Tabs, and Inputs.

TABLES: Build the ledger table using semantic HTML (table, thead, tbody, tr, td) styled with Tailwind for high precision. Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrapper for tables to maintain the edge-to-edge 'Linear' feel.
ALIGNMENT: Ensure all monetary values ($ amount) are right-aligned and use 'tabular-nums' Tailwind class to prevent width-shifting during loading or sorting.
FORBIDDEN: Do not use purple/violet gradients. Do not use Inter or Roboto fonts. Do not use generic 90s box-shadows.
